notes: Figures from the ZEISS V8 product page 'Technical Data' (global English site): magnification, field of view at 100 m, 'Elevation Adjustment Range at 100 m' (in cm, used as elevation_travel with 1 cm clicks), 'Adjustment per Click at 100 m' 1 cm, main tube. The 2026 North America catalog (p.146) gives the same click as '1 cm / 0.1 MRAD'. Illuminated (fibre-optic illuminated dot). Reticle options on the product page: 54 | 60. Figures from the ZEISS V8 product page 'Technical Data' (global English site): magnification, field of view at 100 m, 'Elevation Adjustment Range at 100 m' (in cm, used as elevation_travel with 1 cm clicks), 'Adjustment per Click at 100 m' 1 cm, main tube. The 2026 North America catalog (p.146) gives the same click as '1 cm / 0.1 MRAD'. Illuminated (fibre-optic illuminated dot). Zeiss names the model 1.8-14x50 but its technical data (product page and manual) give 1.8-13.5x. The #60 datasheet's column is '14x', beyond the true 13.5x maximum, so the reticles are rescaled to hold at 13.5x. Reticle options on the product page: 54 | 60; the #54 datasheet (10/2021) marks 1.8-14x50 as 'not available' and has figures only up to 8x, so zeiss-54-v8-1-8-14x50 is an ESTIMATE scaled from the V8 #54 table (see reticles.md). The US catalog lists only #60. Windage 200 cm. Parallax 50 m to infinity.

Figures from the ZEISS V8 product page 'Technical Data' (global English site): magnification, field of view at 100 m, 'Elevation Adjustment Range at 100 m' (in cm, used as elevation_travel with 1 cm clicks), 'Adjustment per Click at 100 m' 1 cm, main tube. The 2026 North America catalog (p.146) gives the same click as '1 cm / 0.1 MRAD'. Illuminated (fibre-optic illuminated dot). Reticle options (global): 43 | 60. Figures from the ZEISS V8 product page 'Technical Data' (global English site): magnification, field of view at 100 m, 'Elevation Adjustment Range at 100 m' (in cm, used as elevation_travel with 1 cm clicks), 'Adjustment per Click at 100 m' 1 cm, main tube. Figures from the Conquest V6 product page 'Technical Data' (global site) and the Conquest V6 manual. Figures from the Conquest V6 product page 'Technical Data' (global site) and the Conquest V6 manual. Click 1/4 MOA (0.7 cm/100 m); elevation 180 cm = 62 MOA (manual: 62x34 MOA (180x100 cm)). Reticle options (global): 43 | ZBR-1 | ZMOA-1; reticle 43 exists illuminated and non-illuminated (both datasheets list V6 5-30x50). US catalog adds AHR (#90, non-illuminated) and its #6 table also shows a 'Conquest V6 5-30x50 @30x' column, but #6 is not in the model's reticle list anywhere (product page, spec table, #6 datasheet says not available), so #6 is not listed. reticle_reference_magnification 30 (maximum; #43 and AHR figures at 30x). NOTE: ZBR-1 and ZMOA-1 on this model are calibrated at 25x (1 MOA tick spacing at 25x in both datasheets; catalog ZBR-1 '@ 25x'); their reticle entries carry published_at_magnification 25.
